> **The pack is under a feature freeze** ([docs/MAINTENANCE.md](../../docs/MAINTENANCE.md)). This is still worth filing: requests are counted, and 10 distinct requests for the same thing lifts the freeze. It will not be built the week you file it, and that is the policy working rather than the issue being ignored.
